CEO and board
Board confidential · built on synthetic benchmark data

slides.title: Executive summary

paragraphs.text: Executive summary
Enter the US in 2027 through Amazon, not national retail, as a gated launch: it fits the board's limits but reaches $26.4M in 2030 and pays back only below 28.6% ad cost
The US is worth entering, and Amazon is where its K-beauty buyers shop
–	K-beauty took 39% of US facial skincare growth in 2021–25, to $3.6B
–	Pilot units nearly doubled in six months; repeat and ad cost are thin
A national retail launch in 2027 would break the board's limits
–	At Onsoo's awareness, sell-through is 2.6 units per door a week, below 4.0
–	Even on plan inputs, retail needs $20.8M by 2030, above the $18M cap
The Amazon route fits the limits, but ad cost decides whether it pays back by 2030
–	Payback needs ACoS below 28.6%; the pilot ran at 28%, the benchmark 32%
–	Japan is safer but adds $7.0M of 2030 revenue, against $26.4M
Launch on Amazon behind five gates, restate the ambition as $40M by 2032 and hold retail until awareness passes 20%
–	At its planned pace the Amazon route passes $40M only around 2032
–	Gates on ad cost, duty, repeat, cash and awareness trigger a scale-back
